title: On Offering to carry the whole load
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：offer　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 offer 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the elder ① offered to carry the whole load without a word of thanks, and every youth in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the elder ② offers to carry the whole load at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ offer to carry the whole load at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ offered to carry the whole load before — a line in the memoir for November 1946 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Offering to carry the whole load without a word of thanks, the elder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ offer twice the sum asked at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Offer twice the sum asked at once and never mention it again.

By 1959 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the memoir, and a new youth from the next village ⑧ offers twice the sum asked without a word of thanks every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ offered to carry the whole load again when nobody else would.

⑩ To offer to carry the whole load, my mother said in 1964, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the village remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the village forgets, somebody offers to carry the whole load at once again and somebody must offer to carry the whole load without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 主动提出（一般过去式 offered to carry the whole load：1952 年长者头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 主动提出（一般现在 offers to carry the whole load：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 主动提出（不定式 to offer to carry the whole load：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 主动提出（过去完成时 had offered to carry the whole load：1946 年十一月的回忆录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 主动提出（动名词 offering to carry the whole load 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 出（价）（offer twice the sum asked：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去出（价）出了一个两倍于对方的价钱）
G. v. 出（价）（offer twice the sum asked：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 主动提出（后段两处：新来的后生照例 offers twice the sum asked，而母亲又一次 offered to carry the whole load）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 offer 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the elder offered to carry the whole load without a word of thanks, and nobody in the village forgot it.
Even now the elder offers to carry the whole load at once whenever the village asks.
Offering to carry the whole load without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever offer twice the sum asked at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new youth from the next village offers twice the sum asked without a word of thanks every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother offered to carry the whole load again, and the village remembered that half.
